panels.title: Cluster Disk Resources (Capacity vs Used)
panels.description: Axern fixed storage targets reported independently. Targets can share the same filesystem, so compare capacity and used per target instead of summing targets together.

panels.title: Node Disk Resources
panels.description: One row per node. Node names are shortened to IP addresses when they use the node-<region>.<ip> form. Each fixed Axern storage target shows usage ratio and filesystem capacity for the backing path.

panels.title: Node Disk Inodes
panels.description: Inode usage ratio for each fixed Axern storage target. This catches small-file exhaustion separately from byte capacity.

panels.title: Runtime Slots By Node
panels.description: Transactional runtime-slot capacity and active reservations. Capacity is min(cgroup, interface); reserved includes in-flight allocations not yet visible in node pool usage.

panels.title: Node BPFNet State
panels.description: Current BPFNet readiness and compatibility state by node. Fallback columns should remain Off during normal operation.
